sql.lock_user: SELECT user_id FROM n_users WHERE user_id=:user_id AND is_active=1 AND status='active' FOR UPDATE
sql.save: MERGE INTO n_ai_user_providers p USING (SELECT :user_id AS user_id,:preset_id AS preset_id,:base_url AS base_url,:model_name AS model_name,:secret_box AS secret_box,:enabled AS enabled,:revision AS revision FROM dual) s ON (p.user_id=s.user_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p.preset_id=s.preset_id,p.base_url=s.base_url,p.model_name=s.model_name,p.secret_box=s.secret_box,p.enabled=s.enabled,p.revision=s.revision,p.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id,preset_id,base_url,model_name,secret_box,enabled,revision) VALUES(s.user_id,s.preset_id,s.base_url,s.model_name,s.secret_box,s.enabled,s.revision)
